description: This file defines the interface GatewaySignalEnrichmentProvider, which provides a method to obtain a SignalEnrichmentFacade based on an HTTP request, intended for use within a gateway's signal enrichment workflow.

classes.name: GatewaySignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: An interface providing a method to create SignalEnrichmentFacade instances from HTTP requests, to support signal enrichment in gateway endpoints.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Creates and returns a SignalEnrichmentFacade based on the provided HTTP request, used for signal enrichment in websocket or SSE streams.
